svg.title: Speed vs. reasoning quality: Stage 2 vs. Stage 3
svg.desc: Chart plots classifier p50 latency from 0.8 s to 3.5 s against GPQA Diamond reasoning quality from 84 percent to 96 percent across two models: Stage 2 gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview at 0.8 s p50 and 86.9 percent GPQA Diamond (37 percent of calls) and Stage 3 gemini-3.1-pro-preview at 3.5 s p50 and 94.3 percent GPQA Diamond (3 percent of calls).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Speed vs. reasoning quality (Stage 2 vs. Stage 3)
